description: Route daily Logstash-style index names (<prefix>-YYYY.MM.DD) to monthly indices (<prefix>-YYYY.MM). Keeps shard count bounded on a single node without changing any shipper. Names that are not daily pass through unchanged.

script.source: String i = ctx._index; int n = i.length(); if (n > 11 && i.charAt(n-3) == (char)46 && i.charAt(n-6) == (char)46 && Character.isDigit(i.charAt(n-1)) && Character.isDigit(i.charAt(n-2)) && Character.isDigit(i.charAt(n-4)) && Character.isDigit(i.charAt(n-5))) { ctx._index = i.substring(0, n-3); }
